title: An improved method for efficient recovery of high quality DNA from date palm (Phoenix dactylifera L; Arecaceae)
author: Safeena, Dissanayake, et al.

steps.title: Grind leaf tissue
steps.instruction: Grind leaf tissue into a fine powder using liquid nitrogen and a mortar and pestle.

steps.title: Homogenize in CTAB buffer
steps.instruction: Suspend the powdered tissue in 2 % CTAB buffer containing 1 M Tris‑HCl (pH 8.0), 5 M NaCl, 0.5 M EDTA, 2 % CTAB and 2 % β‑mercaptoethanol; homogenize thoroughly.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenate at 4 °C, ≤12 000 × g for 5 min; transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube.

steps.title: First chloroform:IAA extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of chloroform:IAA (24:1) to the supernatant, mix, then centrifuge at 4 °C, ≤10 000 × g for 10 min; collect the upper aqueous phase.

steps.title: Second chloroform:IAA extraction
steps.instruction: Repeat the chloroform:IAA extraction as in step 4.

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add 3 µl RNase A (10 µg ml⁻¹) to the recovered aqueous phase and incubate at 37 °C for 1 h (optional).

steps.title: DNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the RNase‑treated mixture to a new 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube containing two‑thirds volume of ice‑cold isopropanol, incubate at 4 °C for 20–40 min, then centrifuge at 4 °C, ≤12 000 × g for 10 min to pellet DNA.

steps.title: Ethanol wash of DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet three times: (a) remove and discard supernatant, (b) add 150 µl 75 % ethanol, (c) centrifuge at 4 °C, ≤14 000 × g for 10 min, (d) discard supernatant; repeat steps a–c two additional times. Remove supernatant by gently sloping the tube to avoid collapsing the pellet.

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Pulse‑spin the pellet at room temperature and carefully aspirate remaining ethanol with a micropipette.

steps.title: Air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the pellet to evaporate residual ethanol for 30 min (alternatively, tilt the tube onto a kimwipe to remove ethanol).

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in TE
steps.instruction: Add 20–30 µl 1/10 TE buffer and resuspend the pellet at 4 °C.

steps.title: Quantify and store DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration, then use immediately or store at –80 °C.
